rootCauseDiagnostics.conclusion: Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 still behaves as observed in R4. The failure is caused by the smoke runner's sanitized PATH allowlist: DSH's pwsh resolution tries Program Files/PowerShell/7, then every PATH entry's pwsh.exe, then falls back to System32 WindowsPowerShell 5.1. This host has pwsh 7.6.5 only via a user-directory install that is on the normal user PATH but not on the runner's allowlist, so the fixture-owned write ran under the 5.1 fallback and its read-only sandbox result no longer contained the observed 'sandbox: file access denied' tool_result dialect the fixture matches; the permission stage therefore stayed at stage 1 and session/request_permission was never reached.
rootCauseDiagnostics.fixDirection: Runner fixtureEnvironment (packages/dsh-adapter/src/native.ts) needs a reviewed way to resolve or allowlist a verified pwsh 7 location (e.g. add an operator-verified pwsh directory to PATH, or an explicit pinned pwsh path), instead of silently degrading to the 5.1 fallback. Implementation and dialect decision belong to the maintainer; no source was changed for this run.
